隠れていた双頭の斧の機体が次々に姿を見せる。: Units from the Double-Headed Axe that were hiding show themselves one after another.
まあ、伏兵は配置しておくよな。: Well, it makes sense they'd lay an ambush.
べつにほめているわけじゃないぞ。\n作戦として妥当だなって感想なだけで。: I'm not particularly praising them. It's just an observation that it's a sound tactic.
あの方達は最初からまともな交渉をするつもりなど、\nなかったのですわ。: Those people had no intention of conducting proper negotiations from the very beginning.
先に拉致したジュリーを解放してくれたのだし、\nそれはないと思いたいが……: They released Julie, whom they'd abducted earlier, so I'd like to think that wasn't the case, but...
そういや、ジュリーは無事なんだな？: Speaking of which, Julie is safe, right?
ええ、もちろんですわ。\n今はわたくしの予備シートに座っていただいております。: Yes, of course. She is currently sitting in my spare seat.
ええ、まったく問題ないわ。みんなのこと、信じていたし。\n必ず迎えに来るって。: Yes, I'm completely fine. I believed in everyone after all. That you'd definitely come for me.
会話してる間も双頭の斧による攻撃は続いており、\n俺達はこの場を離脱することがで: Even as we conversed, the attacks from the Double-Headed Axe continued, keeping us from pulling back from this location.
ジュリーの奪還に成功し、ちゆるを渡さずに済んだのだから\nあとは無事に撤退さえで: We succeeded in rescuing Julie and didn't have to hand over Chiyuru, so now all we need to do is pull off a safe retreat, but...
ちょ、ちょっとぉ～。\nこの数の違いはひどくない！？: W-Wait a sec～! Isn't this difference in numbers way too terrible!?
さっきからどこからともなく、支援射撃があるのよね。: There's been support fire coming from out of nowhere for a while now.
一体どこから弾が飛んできてるの？: Where on earth are those shots flying in from?
風紀委員が何とかこの場所を割り出して来てくれた……\nとは考えられないでしょうか: Could it be that the Disciplinary Committee somehow tracked down this location and came to help us...?
違うだろうな。少なくとも味方の識別信号ではない。: I doubt it. At the very least, it's not an ally's identification signal.
それどころか機体の位置すら把握できていない。: In fact, we can't even grasp the position of the unit.
霞光には一般のＭＧよりも優れたセンサーが搭載されているが、\n対空レーダーにも対: The Kakou is equipped with sensors superior to general MGs, but there's no response on either anti-air radar or counter-battery radar.
（何か得体のしれないものが、この場に干渉している……？）: (Is something unidentified interfering with this battlefield...?)
まるで幽霊のようだ……そう思ったのだった。: It's almost like a ghost... That was what I thought.
上空からの支援攻撃は恐ろしいまでに正確無比――: The supporting attacks from above are terrifically accurate—
レーダーの範囲外から精密射撃をしているの……？\nほんと頭おかしいんじゃない？: Conducting precision fire from outside radar range...? Are they seriously out of their mind?
まあ、それだけ、どうしてもＴ２元素応用技術を\n完成させたいってことか……: Well, it just goes to show how badly they want to complete the T2 Element Application Technology...
だったら……やるしかないわね。: In that case... we have no choice but to do this.
各機、目標以外のシリウスシュガー機を排除せよ。: All units, eliminate the Sirius Sugar machines other than the target.
目標は……私が確実に殺す！: The target... I will kill without fail!
（……腹を決めなさい、コトハ。\n目的を達成するために、行動するって決めたでしょ: (...Make up your mind, Kotoha. You decided to take action to achieve your goal, didn't you?)
双頭の斧の動きに変化があった。: There was a shift in the Double-Headed Axe's movements.
敵指揮官機――コトハ機がちゆる機と交戦できるように\n誘導しているようだ。: The enemy commander unit—Kotoha's machine—seems to be steering the battle so she can engage Chiyuru's unit.
ここは向こうの思惑に乗ってあげようかな。: Maybe I should play along with her scheme here.
いいのか？ どう考えても、殺しに来てるぞ。: Are you sure? No matter how you look at it, she's coming to kill you.
コトハ機は甘さなど微塵も感じさせない\n鬼気迫る攻撃を繰り出している。: Kotoha's unit unleashes an ominous, intense assault without a single trace of leniency.
まだ話し合いは終わってないと思うから。: Because I don't think our discussion is over yet.
……わかった。信じてるぞ。\n他のやつらには手を出させない。: ...Got it. I trust you. I won't let the others lay a hand on you.
ちゆる機が突出し、コトハ機との距離を詰める。: Chiyuru's unit surged forward, closing the distance to Kotoha's unit.
そっちもその気なら話が早い！: If you're up for it too, that makes things quick!
違う！ あたしは話し合いをするつもり！: No! I intend to talk it out!
なら、私達の仲間になる？\n未来永劫、Ｔ２元素応用技術研究をやめてくれる？: Then will you join us? Will you abandon your T2 Element Application Technology research for all eternity?
それはできない相談だね。: That's something I can't agree to.
そう……なら、殺すしかなさそうね。: I see... Then it looks like I have no choice but to kill you.
操縦技量ではコトハの方が上だ。\nしかも殺すつもりで攻撃をしている。: In terms of piloting skill, Kotoha has the upper hand. On top of that, she's attacking with the intent to kill.
だがちゆるはコトハを殺すつもりがないから\n消極的な攻撃しかできない。: However, since Chiyuru has no intention of killing Kotoha, she can only manage passive attacks.
コトハの容赦のない連撃が、ちゆるを追い詰めていく。: Kotoha's relentless barrage of attacks backed Chiyuru into a corner.
確かに重力制御は危険な力かもしれない。\nでもそれを決めるのは、コトハ……キミじ: Gravity control might indeed be a dangerous power. But the one who gets to decide that isn't you, Kotoha!
この技術はきっと人類の役に立つ！\nみんなで議論して乗り越えていけば――: This technology will surely benefit humanity! If we all discuss it and overcome the hurdles together—
その『みんな』を、あんたは信じられるっていうの？: Are you saying you can actually trust that 'everyone'?
目を開け、耳をふさぐな！\nあんたは何もおかしいとは思わないの！？: Open your eyes and don't cover your ears! Don't you think anything about all this is strange!?
なぜザルトゥーム学園なんてものが設立された？: Why was something like Zartum Academy established in the first place?
なぜ利用方法も不明なＴ元素なんてもののために、\n生徒達は危険も顧みずメイズなん: Why are students recklessly challenging the Maze, disregarding the danger, all for T-Elements whose uses aren't even known?
全てが誰かの手のひらの上にあると、そう考えたことはないの！？: Have you never considered that everything is dancing on the palm of someone else's hand!?
ちゆる、下がれ！\n相手は冷静に話ができる状態じゃない！: Chiyuru, fall back! She's in no state to have a calm conversation!
……ううん、ダメ。あたしは逃げない。\nここで逃げたら、きっとあたしはあたしを許: ...No, I can't. I won't run away. If I run away here, I know I'll never be able to forgive myself!
あたしはさ、これまで誰にも正体を明かさず、\n隠れて研究してた。: You know, up until now, I never revealed my true identity to anyone and conducted my research in secret.
自分しか会員のいないメイズ研究同好会なんてものを作って、\nそこでこっそりとね。: I created something like the Maze Research Club with no members other than myself, secretly working there.
本当はもっと『自由な研究』がしたかったはずなのに、\nいつも逃げ場所を探してばか: I was supposed to want 'freer research,' but I was always just looking for a place to run away to.
でもね、逃げた先に結局楽園なんてなかったんだ。: But you see, there was no paradise waiting at the end of running away.
あたしのせいで仲間に迷惑をかけて、\nジュリーにもつらい思いをさせちゃった。: Because of me, I caused trouble for my friends and put Julie through a hard time too.
だからね……もう、逃げないことにした。: So... I've decided not to run away anymore.
あたしは戦って……この手で、『自分の居場所』を勝ち取る！: I will fight... and win 'my place to belong' with these hands!
……わかった。\nなら、迷うな、ちゆる。全力で自分の意志を貫き通せ！: ...Understood. Then don't hesitate, Chiyuru. Pierce straight through with your own will using all your strength!
（なんでだろう……？\n体の奥底から力があふれてくる……）: (Why is this...? Power is welling up from deep inside my body...)
ちゆるなら成せると、俺は信じてるぞ！！: I believe that if it's you, Chiyuru, you can achieve it!!
（あぁ、そっか……きっと、\nあたしのことを信じてくれる人がいるから……）: (Ah, I see... It's surely because there's someone who believes in me...)
理解力がないなら、理解しないままでいい！\nそのまま何もせず、黙って死んで！！: If you lack the intellect to understand, stay ignorant! Just do nothing and quietly die!!
悪いけど、キミに素直に殺されてあげるわけにはいかない！: Sorry, but I can't just obediently let you kill me!
あたしには仲間がいる！ 帰る場所がある！: I have friends! I have a place to return to!
そしていつかちゃんとキミと話し合う必要があるの！！: And I need to have a proper talk with you someday!!
ちゆる機が加速する。\n一直線にコトハ機へと突き進んだ。: Chiyuru's unit accelerated. It charged straight toward Kotoha's unit in a single line.
